title: Y&R's Roxanne Recast: Tatyana Ali Reveals Why She Isn't Returning
summary: Roxanne is returning to Genoa City, but Tatyana Ali won't be playing her. The former Y&R star reveals why she's absent and shares her surprising thoughts about the recast.
body:
The Young and the Restless is bringing back a familiar face from Genoa City's past, but the casting news comes with an unexpected twist. Roxanne, previously portrayed by Tatyana Ali, is returning after a 13-year absence. However, longtime viewers will see Tetona Jackson stepping into the role instead.

For fans who remember Ali's memorable run, the announcement naturally raises questions. Why isn't the actress returning? Has there been any disappointment behind the scenes? Ali has now shared her perspective, offering an interesting glimpse into the situation and some encouraging words for her successor.

### What Just Happened in Genoa City

Tatyana Ali portrayed Roxanne on Y&R from 2007 until 2013. The character originally entered the storyline as a friend of Lily Winters, eventually developing a romantic relationship with Lily's brother, Devon Winters.

Their relationship experienced plenty of complications. Devon's involvement with Tyra created a painful betrayal, leaving Roxanne understandably upset. Although she eventually forgave him, their romance encountered another major obstacle when Devon inherited a fortune from his grandmother, Katherine Chancellor.

Devon became concerned that Roxanne might be interested in his wealth, and those doubts contributed to their eventual breakup.

Now, after more than a decade away, Roxanne is preparing to return to the canvas. Tetona Jackson has been announced as the actress taking over the character, leaving Ali out of the new chapter.

### Why Tatyana Ali Isn't Returning

Ali addressed the casting situation during an interview with TV Insider. Her explanation was surprisingly straightforward: she said she didn't believe anyone from the show had contacted her about returning.

That comment provides an important piece of context for viewers who were hoping to see the original Roxanne again.

However, Ali didn't use the opportunity to criticize the production or express hostility toward the new casting decision. Instead, she offered Jackson her full support and expressed confidence that the actress would do a wonderful job.

Ali also remembered her time at Y&R fondly, describing the environment as welcoming and comparing the experience to being part of a little family.

Her message to Jackson was especially encouraging. She believes the new Roxanne will thoroughly enjoy working alongside Devon and the Winters family, calling the opportunity a true blessing.

It's a gracious response from someone who spent six years helping establish the character.

### What Could Happen Next?

Jackson now has an opportunity to introduce Roxanne to a new generation of viewers while reconnecting longtime fans with the character's history.

Her return also creates interesting possibilities for Devon. Their previous relationship included romance, betrayal, forgiveness, and serious disagreements about wealth and trust. Whether those old feelings will resurface remains to be seen.

For now, the show hasn't confirmed the specific direction of Roxanne's new storyline. Any romantic developments or unresolved conflicts involving Devon should therefore be considered possibilities rather than established events.

Meanwhile, Ali has another major television milestone keeping her busy. She's competing on Season 35 of Dancing with the Stars alongside professional partner Jan Ravnik. On November 17, 2026, the pair secured a place in the finale, putting them in contention for the Mirrorball Trophy.

There's an interesting coincidence, too: DWTS films at Television City, the same studio where Y&R is produced.

Although Ali isn't returning to Genoa City, she's certainly close to her former television home. And with Roxanne preparing for a new chapter, fans have plenty of reasons to watch what happens next.
